sources.title: Annual reports, 1883, 1885-1886, 1898-1901
sources.title_original: Annual Report of the Hebrew Sunday-School Society of Philadelphia
sources.publisher: Temple University Libraries, Special Collections Research Center
sources.notes: Hebrew Sunday School Society of Philadelphia (Pa.) Records, Temple University Libraries, Special Collections Research Center, SCRC 50, Box 2, Folder 2 (Series 1: Administrative records); identifier JHSSMZ202010000018; CONTENTdm record 16649, 132 scans (pageptr 16517–16648). Six printed annual reports bound or filed together: 1883, 1885–6, 1898 (60th), 1899 (61st), 1900 (62nd) and 1901 (63rd). All 132 scans inventoried; 14 lists transcribed as a draft by Claude: two name-only subscriber lists (1883, 1885–6), six donation lists, and four membership lists (1898–1901). Officers, committees, teachers, school statistics and treasurer’s accounts are not transcribed. Page images are linked from Temple’s IIIF server, not copied into the repository. Rights: No Copyright — United States (NoC-US).
